                OUTPUT [--reference REFERENCE] [--fault-review FAULT_REVIEW]
                [--authorized-device-window] [--plan]

One fresh model load: 512-input prefill, then every fixed realistic prompt.

options:

  --lane {A,B}

                        compatibility tests

  --reference REFERENCE
  --fault-review FAULT_REVIEW
  --authorized-device-window
  --plan

usage: pipeline.py [-h] [--binary BINARY] --output OUTPUT [--input INPUT]
                   [--oracle ORACLE] [--dispatch DISPATCH] [--mini] [--device]
                   [--draft DRAFT [DRAFT ...]] [--draft-rank {0,1}]
                   [--target-split {0,23,24}] [--draft-head {full}]
                   [--draft-fault {none,wrong,error,stall,suppress,garbage,late-error}]
                   [--script SCRIPT] [--prompt-overlap {on,off}]
                   [--dump-state] [--card CARD] [--tokens TOKENS]
                   [--context CONTEXT] [--seconds SECONDS]
                   [--wait-seconds WAIT_SECONDS] [--native-nice NATIVE_NICE]
                   [--retain-steps RETAIN_STEPS]
                   [--cancel-launch CANCEL_LAUNCH] [--timing {token,class}]
                   [--suite-manifest SUITE_MANIFEST] [--repeat REPEAT]
                   [--controller {python,native}]
                   [--host-path {legacy,prepared}] [--argument-audit]
                   [--audit-prepare-each]

Bounded two-process controller; CPU host backend by default. No threads.
